'''kpimenatl COTVG with a tune up''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[kpimenatl]]
* '''Published:''' 28 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / Vile Gangsters|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Strategy:''' Court Of The Vile Gangster
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Vile kpimenatl DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I gave this deck a face lift. I just want to know how much better this is.

== Strategy ==

I have tuned it up. I don't have that bones card everyone seems to be talking about, so don't put that in response.

I put some bountys in there because if you can't flip the objective you can still retrieve force through bountys. I also put them in there because Bossk w/mg receives a special bonus.

I added a whole all the trap doors I have. I also put Sarlaac in there.

This objective is not too hard to flip, I don't think.
